changelog:
Validate auto-refresh modes before configuration access and locking. Report precise file/chunk size failures without weakening acceptance limits. Add qualified recovery advice to incomplete file-tool errors; preserve JSON validation, timeout and retry semantics.
修复自动刷新非法模式校验顺序与独立测试崩溃；精确报告文件和分段超限；工具停滞错误提供小块完整编辑建议，不放宽验收或改变超时重试规则。
